item.title: Kashmir Fringe Set For Quay Arts Return
item.description: Kashmir Café has been a festival favourite for more than a decade, run entirely by Island volunteers.

item.title: Island Community Pays Tribute To Much-Loved Tristan Price After Fatal Godshill Crash
item.description: Tributes have been paid to a much-loved Isle of Wight man who died following a serious crash near Godshill at the weekend.

item.title: Historic East Wight Barn Could Be Converted Into Two-Bedroom Home
item.description: A historic farm barn in East Wight could be transformed into a two-bedroom house, under plans submitted for Duxmore Farm, located east of Robin Hill Country Park.

item.title: Isle Of Wight Pianist Thomas Luke Set For Debut Album Release
item.description: Isle of Wight-born pianist and composer Thomas Luke is set to release his debut album of original music, See Me Now, on Friday 16 January.

item.title: Community Rallies Around Family Of Much-Loved Ventnor RFC Player After Fatal Crash
item.description: A GoFundMe page has now been set up to help Tristan’s family with immediate funeral and memorial costs.

item.title: Driver Escapes Serious Injury After Car Overturns On Ryde Road
item.description: Fire crews from Ryde and Sandown assisted the driver from the vehicle, with the Isle of Wight Ambulance Service providing care at the scene.

item.title: CCTV Image Issued Following Shoplifting In Ryde
item.description: Police have issued a CCTV image of man they would like to speak to after a shoplifting incident at Sainsbury’s on Union Street, Ryde.

item.title: Top Five Music Videos You Only Ever Saw During January Chart Shows
item.description: January had a very specific vibe. Christmas was over. School was back. The decorations were gone, but the glitter hadn’t quite worn off yet. And on TV? January was chart show season — long countdowns, half-hearted enthusiasm, and music videos that felt cold, moody, and slightly depressing. These weren’t summer bangers. These were songs that thrived in darkness, coat collars, and emotional close-ups. Here are five music videos you swear you only ever saw during January chart shows — usually...

item.title: Top Five January School Assemblies Everyone Dreaded
item.description: January assemblies hit differently. The Christmas holidays were over. The excitement was gone. And the hall smelled faintly of wet coats and disappointment. You’d shuffle in, sit cross-legged on the cold floor, and know — deep down — that whatever was coming next would not be good news. Here are the five January school assemblies that struck fear into the hearts of pupils everywhere. 5. The “New Year, New Rules” Assembly This one always arrived with a suspiciously cheerful opening. Smiles....

item.title: Island Holiday Let Businesses Boosted By New Atlas Ferries and Wightlink Partnership
item.description: Small holiday-let businesses across the Isle of Wight are benefitting from a partnership between Wightlink and Ryde-based travel company Atlas Ferries.
